English.Char_Desc_80: Dual-pane file manager with SSH, terminal, and built-in file viewers.
English.Char_Desc_250: Hexone is a fast, keyboard-driven dual-pane file manager for Windows. Browse local and SSH/SFTP files, work with pane and terminal tabs, and inspect text, code, hex, images, PDFs, logs, and binary files without leaving the application.
English.Char_Desc_450: Hexone is a fast, keyboard-driven dual-pane file manager for Windows. It combines local file management, SSH/SFTP browsing, pane tabs, favorites, sorting, multi-file rename, and an integrated multi-tab terminal. Its built-in viewer opens text, syntax-highlighted code, hexadecimal data, images, PDFs, logs, and binary files, with search and large-file support.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
Hexone is a fast, keyboard-driven dual-pane file manager designed for efficient local and remote file work. Use independent pane tabs, sorting, favorites, file operations, archive extraction, and multi-file rename without leaving the application. Browse remote systems over SSH/SFTP and view remote files directly. The integrated terminal supports multiple tabs and follows the active pane directory.
A built-in viewer handles plain text, syntax-highlighted source code, hexadecimal data, images, PDFs, command output, logs, and binary files. Search works across supported viewing modes, while large-file handling avoids loading an entire multi-gigabyte log or binary into memory.
Hexone is free and open source under the Apache License 2.0 and contains no telemetry, analytics, advertising, or publisher-operated cloud services.
